title: Mind the Gap: Pitfalls of LLM Alignment with Asian Public Opinion
reasoning: The study specifically focuses on the domain of religion as the primary prism for evaluating cultural alignment. It utilizes multiple religion-focused benchmarks and subsets (such as the religion subset of CrowS-Pairs and the IndiBias religion plausibility task) to analyze how LLMs represent religious viewpoints and identities across India and East/Southeast Asia.
